tapes.no_recorder: Equip recorder or upgrade Intelligence Center in the Hideout
item.not_for_flea: Cannot be listed on Flea Market
settings.hint.HeadBobbing: Enhances immersion, but high values may cause motion sickness.
settings.hint.Fov: Shows how wide the visible game world is. Higher values provide a wider field of view.
settings.hint.ClearRam: Enables forced memory cleanup between raids to improve performance. Recommended for players with less than 16 GB RAM.
settings.hint.SetAffinity: Disables the use of virtual CPU cores.
settings.hint.MalfunctionVisibility: Displays notifications about weapon malfunctions in the corner of the screen.
settings.hint.PreloadHideout: Increases resource usage in the main menu but speeds up Hideout loading.
settings.hint.TraderIntermediateScreen: Shows a separate trader selection screen when opening the Trading tab.
settings.hint.VSync: Limits FPS to the monitor refresh rate to reduce screen tearing.
settings.hint.Antialiasing:
FXAA — Low performance impact, but may blur the image;

TAA — A modern anti-aliasing method with minimal performance impact and less blurring. May cause flickering and object ghosting.
settings.hint.VolumeLight: Provides realistic light beams and shadow scattering. Can heavily load the GPU.
settings.hint.NvidiaDlss: A technology that improves performance and overall image quality. Effective at reconstructing small details. Supported only on RTX graphics cards and may slightly blur the image on high-resolution displays.
settings.hint.DlssPreset:
F — Default preset for Max Performance and DLAA modes.

J — Improves DLSS upscaling and image detail. Affects Performance and Quality modes and delivers better results compared to other CCN models.

K — Enhanced version of preset J that reduces grass flickering and ghosting artifacts.

L — Sharper image with a focus on detail. Gives a crisp picture in Quality and Performance modes, but in some scenes may increase the flickering of fine details.

M — Prioritizes image stability. Gives a softer and steadier picture than L.
settings.hint.AmdFsr22: An image upscaling technology that improves performance and visual quality using temporal upscaling. Works on most graphics cards without additional hardware requirements.
settings.hint.AmdFsr3: An image upscaling technology that additionally uses Frame Generation to increase FPS by 1.5 to 2 times. May slightly increase input lag.
settings.hint.Resampling:
Changes the internal rendering resolution without altering the game window size.
Performance impact depends on the selected value.
settings.hint.Hbao: Adds soft ambient shadows for greater depth and improved spatial perception.
settings.hint.Ssr: Adds reflections only for objects currently visible on screen. More resource-efficient than Ray Tracing but may introduce visual artifacts.
settings.hint.AnisoFilter: Improves the quality of textures viewed at sharp angles.
settings.hint.NvidiaReflexLowLatency: Reduces system latency between input actions and on-screen response. Useful when you need fastest reaction time.
settings.hint.FramerateLimit:
When enabled, the frame rate limit caps maximum FPS, reduces hardware load, prevents overheating, and ensures stable frame pacing.

When disabled, the game renders the maximum possible FPS, improving smoothness and reducing input lag. This increases GPU and CPU load and may cause FPS fluctuations on low-end systems.
settings.hint.HqColor: Improves color accuracy and smoothness for a more realistic image. May increase GPU load and require compatible monitors.
settings.hint.ZBlur: Adds depth-of-field blur to objects out of focus, enhancing visual immersion.
settings.hint.ChromaticAberrations: Adds color fringing at object edges for a cinematic effect. May reduce image clarity and cause eye strain.
settings.hint.Noise: Adds film grain to the image.
settings.hint.GrassShadow: Adds realistic shadows to grass, increasing scene depth and detail.
settings.hint.MipStreaming: Loads textures dynamically on demand to save video memory. May temporarily reduce detail on distant objects. Recommended for graphics cards with less than 8 GB of VRAM.
settings.hint.EnablePostFx: Post-processing effects applied after the main rendering pass. Used to enhance visuals, atmosphere, or scene realism.
settings.hint.LumaSharpen: A filter that increases the clarity of light and dark details without affecting colors. Makes the image more contrast-rich. High values may introduce grain and noise.
settings.hint.AdaptiveSharpen: A smart sharpening filter that enhances clarity only where needed. Used to counter slight blur from DLSS or FSR and improve detail without excessive artifacts.
settings.hint.ColorBlind: Adjusts environment colors to ensure important gameplay elements remain distinguishable for players with color vision deficiencies. Doesn't impact performance.
settings.hint.InvertX: Inverts horizontal camera movement. Moving the mouse right turns the view left and vice versa.
settings.hint.InvertY: Inverts vertical camera movement. Moving the mouse backward looks up, moving it forward looks down.
settings.usage.AvgDecrease-Fov: Slightly reduces performance (at higher FOV values)
settings.usage.HIGH_DECREASE_Resampling: Significantly reduces performance (at 2x or higher values)
settings.usage.LowIncrease-FramerateLimi: Slightly increases performance but may reduce stability
settings.note.ResamplingTitle: Unavailable when DLSS, FSR 2.2, or FSR 3.0 is enabled.
